Option 2: "آری به یمن لطف شما خاک زر شود - از کیمیای عشق تو زر گشت روی من". Translation: "Yes, by your grace, the earth becomes gold - from the alchemy of your love, my face turned to gold". So concept: transformation of base material to gold via love, alchemy, praising beloved's grace. Theme: love as alchemical transformation, turning ordinary to precious.

Option 3: "ای کم از شبنم تو هم آیینه را پرداز ده - شبنم از روشندلی آیینه خورشید شد". Translation: "O less than your dew, also make the mirror (process) - dew from the brilliance became the mirror of the sun". Something about dew reflecting, mirror, transformation of dew into mirror of sun. Might be about reflection, clarity, perhaps love's reflection.

Option 4: "قطره باران ما گوهر یکدانه شد - گریه شبام و سحر شکر که ضایع نگشت". Translation: "Our raindrop became a single gem - the tears of night and morning sugar that were not wasted". So concept: tears (rain) become a gem, gratitude, not wasted. Theme of transformation of tears into something precious, gratitude.
